name: NYC Parks Drinking Fountains
description:
This dataset lists drinking fountains in New York City parks, with 3,849 sampled records and 12 fields. Each row represents a single fountain, identified by a system code and a GIS property number, and linked to a named park property and a parent location (such as a building or larger site). Records include the fountain type, its position within the park (for example, in a playground, in shade, under a tree, or indoors), whether it is painted, the number of fountains at the location, the borough, the managing department code, and a short description. Borough is recorded as a single-letter code (B, Q, M, X, R), and all sampled fountains carry an "Active" feature status. Some fields are incomplete: position is missing for about 6% of rows and painted status for about 25%.
